# Support

Thanks for using this project! To keep the bug tracker focused on actionable bugs, please use the right channel below.

## Usage questions

For "how do I…" questions, configuration help, or general discussion, please use
[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/orgs/org/discussions) instead of opening an issue.

## Documentation

Start with the project docs and the README before filing anything:

- [README](../README.md)
- [Documentation](https://github.com/org/repo#readme)

## Bug reports

If you have found a reproducible bug, open an issue using the bug report template.
Please include the version, a minimal reproduction, and the exact command you ran.

## Security vulnerabilities

**Do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.**
Report them privately following the process in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
This includes vulnerabilities in the scanner itself.
